sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Media Relations and Crisis Public Relations Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore / international companies regime under the International Companies Act 2020)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus trade and investment framework (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)
Scheduled double-taxation arrangements under the Income Tax Act 2012 (not generally engaged by a tax-exempt International Company)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2020 (ICA 2020); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007; Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT directives and FATF-aligned guidance; ICA 2020 registered-agent record-keeping and UBO-documentation obligations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of Samoa International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade where the destination state is an Apostille Convention member; otherwise consular legalization via the relevant Samoan diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Compliance)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade; consular legalization fallback for non-HCCH states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (certified bilingual English-Chinese copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed registered agent in Samoa, with notarized certification by a Samoan Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Subscriber and UBO statutory declaration (attestation of beneficial ownership and source of funds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in Samoa executing on behalf of the registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial deed then Hague Apostille or consular legalization as required by the receiving bank or counsel

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory affirmative screening of all subscriber shareholders, directors, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners against (i) the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic watchlists, (ii) the UN Consolidated List, (iii) OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, (iv) UK HMT consolidated sanctions, and (v) EU consolidated financial sanctions; PEP status must be resolved with source-of-funds evidence before incorporation; the engagement is classified Low_Risk_Standard, permitting simplified due diligence, but screening, UBO attestation, and ongoing transaction monitoring remain compulsory and are documented by the registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies and International Companies Registry under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); name search and clearance are filed electronically by the licensed registered agent through the MCIL registry system (www.mcil.gov.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registered corporate name must be expressed in Latin-alphabet characters and must terminate in a recognized legal-form suffix ('Limited' or 'Ltd'); a Chinese-language name may be adopted as an auxiliary/secondary trading name transliterated into Latin script, and the charter may be executed in a bilingual English-Chinese edition for the traditional Chinese clientele; names in Samoan or foreign scripts are romanized for indexation and publication purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's registered agent files a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, identifying the grounds of distinctiveness, providing evidence of availability, and attaching the prior written consents of the Minister or sector regulator for any restricted tokens; the Registrar must issue a reconsideration decision within 14 days; a further administrative review may be requested through the Samoa International Finance Authority, and an alternative filing may be resubmitted immediately under a different proposed name without forfeiting the previously paid search fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible in substance, provided that the statutory registered office in Samoa is the physical office of the licensed registered agent in Apia; the International Company is not required to lease premises or engage employees in Samoa, and the registered agent's address may be used for service of process and all statutory communications; a stand-alone co-working or mail-forwarding virtual address cannot substitute for the registered agent's registered-office obligation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this engagement: baseline unannounced inspection probability is below 5% per annum for a non-resident-owned, tax-exempt IC in the Low_Risk_Standard public-relations consultancy category with no local operations; the probability would rise to moderate if suspicious-transaction reports, UBO opacity, or nominee misuse indicators are triggered, because the Registrar and the Central Bank of Samoa may direct the registered agent to present original records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory processing fee per consent application

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation filing fee (International Company, share capital within standard range)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Expedited incorporation processing and courier of certificate (optional fast-track)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Optional expedite surcharge on prevailing registry tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service, year one (including UBO register maintenance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Samoa IC agent and registered office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO / AML-KYC onboarding bundle (identity verification, UBO attestation, corporate records, sanctions/PEP docket)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / appointed compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscriptions (UN, OFAC, UK HMT, EU, Samoa FIU, commercial PEP database)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Third-party data-licensing benchmark, passed through at cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization bundle (Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Memorandum and Articles; 3 instruments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Samoa (or Samoan consular post where consular legalization applies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory authentication fee plus courier and per-instrument handling benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987, as amended (Sections 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 58 and 62)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form 1) accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be expressed in any currency and issued with or without par value. No escrow or initial capital deposit requirement applies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the founding directors of the Company that: (1) the subscription and allotment of one ordinary share of no par value to the initial shareholder is approved; (2) the registered office of the Company as notified in the Application for Incorporation is adopted; (3) each founding director and the company secretary appointed under the Articles shall hold office until the next annual meeting; (4) the licensed registered agent in Samoa is engaged as statutory agent for service of process; (5) bank account openings and authorised signatories are approved; (6) operations shall commence only upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation and completion of applicable licensing review. This resolution binds the Company forthwith.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — e-registry window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The SIFA-licensed registered agent submits the name reservation request via the SIFA e-registry. The proposed name must not imply a government connection or regulated banking, insurance, trust or fund business unless separately licensed. The Registrar checks the name against the reserved list and reserves an approved name for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Proposed name list with three alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused, the agent files revised alternates within 7 days; an appeal may be lodged with the Registrar under section 8 of the International Companies Act 1987 within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles in conformity with the International Companies Act 1987, including objects, share capital (no minimum requirement), and director and secretary provisions. The subscriber executes the documents with notarised signature; the agent performs AML/CFT identity verification of all directors, shareholders and beneficial owners.
required_dossiers: AML/CFT due diligence pack (certified passports, proof of address, source of funds declarations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Drafting queries raised by the Registrar are corrected and the documents re-executed; resubmission within 15 days of the query cures the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent electronically files Form 1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles. The agent signs the declaration of compliance. The constitution becomes effective only upon endorsement by the Registrar, after which the company is constituted as a juridical person.
required_dossiers: Notarised Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the agent submits corrected filings within the statutory 21-day response period; escalation to the SIFA Supervision Committee is available if the registry exceeds the SLA without cause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Finance and Accounts Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Payment of the standard incorporation fee of USD 750 is made by interbank wire transfer to the Government of Samoa consolidated account, quoting the SIFA invoice reference. The SIFA receipt is a mandatory pre-condition for issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation. No stamp duty is payable on international company instruments.
required_dossiers: Bank wire transfer (SWIFT MT103) or direct deposit receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Payment reconciliation disputes are resolved by presenting the SWIFT MT103 or deposit slip to SIFA Finance; erroneously allocated funds are re-directed within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of the filed documents and fee receipt, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation. The certificate is released to the licensed registered agent, who forwards a certified copy to the company.
required_dossiers: Registered agent identity verification pack (held on file)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical errors in the certificate are corrected by written request to the Registrar; a re-issued certificate is delivered within 5 business days without additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Officers and Adoption of Registered Office — First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's founding directors and the SIFA-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding directors adopt the first board resolution (or pass a written resolution) approving the share subscription, the registered office at the SIFA-licensed agent's Apia address, and the appointment of directors and secretary. The resolution is minuted and statutory registers are opened at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Share Certificate(s) issued to the initial shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the minutes is cured by a unanimous written consent resolution confirming the original actions; quorum is verified against the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA; offshore banking provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent files any officer particulars confirmation (Form 4) if not already submitted at incorporation, obtains a Certificate of Good Standing, and facilitates the opening of a corporate bank account under the approved retainer and wire payment rails, with signatories as designated in the board resolution.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening pack (board resolution, certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, KYC forms)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries documentation, the agent issues a notarised common seal certificate and re-certified constitutional documents; KYC interview is conducted by secure video call to cure the request.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Licence Compliance Unit; Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) for general business registration only
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no sectoral operating licence required for cross-border media relations and public relations agency services under Schedule 3 of the International Companies Act 1987

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure office-based professional services; no physical works, construction, land disturbance, or industrial discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for industrial discharge; the activity generates no process wastewater, VOCs, or combustion emissions. General workplace compliance is limited to municipal waste handling under the Samoa Waste Management Regulations 2020 and safe electrical workstation standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) for the registered office premises; workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002; building and structural load inspection not required beyond the standard Samoa Building Code compliance for office occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Ministry for Revenue (MfR) — online portal: MfR i-Tax (https://www.revenue.gov.ws)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate as an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 via the Samoa Registrar of International & Foreign Companies (MCIL). Step 2: Apply for a Samoa Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) through the MfR i-Tax portal within 14 days of commencing any taxable activity if the IC employs local staff, leases local property, imports goods, or purchases taxable local supplies (Tax Administration Act 2016, s.67). Step 3: File the TIN application form together with Certificate of Incorporation, memorandum and articles, and director/shareholder identity documents. Step 4: For VAGST, file Form VAGST-REG for compulsory registration once taxable turnover exceeds WST 220,000 in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is available below this threshold to recover input tax. Step 5: MfR issues a consolidated TIN certificate and VAGST registration number accessible via the i-Tax login. A pure offshore PR firm with no Samoan-source income, no local payroll, and no local procurement remains outside the income tax registration net because of the IC's statutory income tax exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Samoan law. An IC is per se exempt from income tax for 20 years from incorporation (International Companies Act 1987). Continuing to hold valid IC status constitutes the operative tax-exempt election; the only elective mechanism is voluntary VAGST registration under s.11 of the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 (as amended), which allows an offshore supplier to register to recover input VAT on local costs, subject to MfR approval. A company may alternatively convert its IC status to that of a domestic company under the International Companies Act 1987, thereby electing into standard entity-level taxation under the Income Tax Act 2012, but this terminates the exemption. No other classification elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 220,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory threshold; voluntary registration permitted below threshold)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or e-invoicing API mandate exists in Samoa. Registered taxpayers must file VAGST returns electronically via the MfR i-Tax portal on a monthly or quarterly basis as directed by the Commissioner. Customs matters are processed through ASYCUDA World for export declarations. There is no live-invoice clearance or continuous transaction control regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for the 0% VAGST rate when physically exported from Samoa within 28 days (extension to 60 days possible) and the exporter retains proof of export. Services qualify for zero-rating when supplied under a written contract to a non-resident person who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and the services are not acquired for use in Samoa. For an International Company providing overseas PR and communication services exclusively to non-resident clients, supplies are zero-rated if VAGST-registered or outside the scope of Samoan VAGST if unregistered. Zero-rating claims require the supplier to hold export documentation, a written service contract, evidence of foreign exchange consideration, and proof of the client's non-resident status.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) endorsed by Samoa Customs Division
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of goods (for service exports: signed service agreement and delivery/performance records)
Inward Remittance Certificate or Central Bank of Samoa exchange control form evidencing repatriation of export proceeds in foreign currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating and refund claims are subject to desk audit and post-clearance review by the MfR. Unsupported or fraudulent claims attract: (i) a shortfall penalty of 50% of the tax underpaid for failure to take reasonable care; (ii) a 150% penalty for intentional evasion; (iii) late-payment interest accruing at 2% per month from the due date; and (iv) criminal prosecution with a fine of up to WST 50,000 and/or up to 12 months' imprisonment for knowingly providing false or misleading information to the Commissioner (Tax Administration Act 2016, ss.68-70, 86). The Commissioner may retrospectively reassess and claw back any refund amount within a 4-year limitation period, extended to 10 years in cases of fraud or evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Fa'aputuputū Tupe Tu'u a Sāmoa), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, exercising delegated exchange control supervision under the Exchange Control Act 1968 (Cap. 214) and the Exchange Control Regulations 1984.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tālā is subject to a partially convertible, exchange-control-supervised regime. Current account transactions, including trade in goods, services remittances, and ordinary consulting retainers, are generally free of prior Central Bank approval, with delegated authority to licensed commercial banks for documentary verification. Capital account transactions remain controlled, requiring explicit Central Bank of Samoa approval for outbound direct investment, resident currency diversification, and certain non-resident financing repayments. For the Samoan International Company in the PR and communications sector, profit remittance is not structurally obstructed provided the entity maintains non-resident offshore status under the International Companies Act 2012; however, Samoa-resident subsidiaries must evidence tax clearance from the Ministry of Revenue and audited financial statements demonstrating distributable after-tax profits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations 1984, exporters must repatriate all export proceeds within 90 days of shipment date. WST-denominated export receipts must be surrendered at 100% conversion to an authorized commercial bank or money changer. Foreign-currency receipt proceeds may be retained in a Samoan Foreign Currency Deposit account, but must be brought into Samoa through a licensed bank within the 90-day statutory period. Deviations or extended repayment terms require written Central Bank of Samoa approval supported by signed trade contracts, invoices, and a compliance declaration from the settlement bank.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for WST-denominated liquidity. Samoa does not license standalone electronic money institutions under the Financial Institutions Act 1996, and non-bank EMIs cannot legally offer deposit-taking or WST settlement. A prudentially regulated offshore EMI may be used solely as an upstream remittance or treasury-on-ramp rail for USD receipts, with final custody and clearing anchored in a licensed Samoan commercial bank or a high-quality international correspondent USD account. Any structure routing funds through an unlicensed offshore EMI without a domestic banking anchor triggers enhanced AML scrutiny and Central Bank of Samoa sanctions risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is the industry standard for principals and signatories opening resident bank accounts in Samoa. For the non-resident International Company, remote account opening is available at ANZ Bank Samoa and Bank of Samoa through a hybrid protocol: notarized corporate board resolutions, certified passport copies, an existing-bank reference letter, a registered agent compliance certificate, and a recorded video interview with the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director. National Bank of Samoa permits remote signing authority but strongly requires the licensed Samoan registered agent to physically attest the identity of each signatory in Apia during the opening process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt entity with no visible commercial substance raises shell-company indicator under the Samoan AML/CFT framework and FATF Recommendation 25 transparency standards.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Samoan International Company Certificate, certified charter or articles of incorporation, board resolution confirming active global PR and crisis communication operations, audited or management-account-prepared Service Delivery Statement, an executed corporate office services agreement in use, a client retainer register with third-party PR contracts, and a narrative business plan evidencing continuous operational activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership arising from family trust or corporate shareholder chain exceeding the 25% threshold identification requirement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form naming each natural person controlling the trust settlor, protector, trustee, and beneficiary classes to the 25% threshold, a redacted trust deed organizational chart endorsed by the trustee, a licensed offshore legal advisor opinion confirming the trust's existence, and a bank-compatible customer due diligence aggregation sheet reconciling the full ownership waterfall.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party capital injection without documentary nexus to contract revenue triggers source-of-funds and wire-structuring suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized source-of-funds affidavit sworn by the beneficial owner, original share subscription minutes evidencing capital contribution purpose, a segregated transfer schedule mapping each incoming remittance to the corresponding share capital or shareholder loan line, and external PR client engagement letters substantiating the commercial revenue trajectory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-level perception of offshore tax-haven opacity diminishes the non-resident International Company's bankability under enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax Exempt Certificate issued under the International Companies Act 2012, a written resolution electing non-resident treatment under Samoan exchange control, a professional services license or equivalent trade registration for the PR activity from the domicile of its operational headquarters, and a detailed substance questionnaire completed by the Samoan registered agent confirming the absence of local-day-to-day management, thereby preserving the tax-exempt offshore profile.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Primary routing is through SWIFT MT103/MT202 correspondent banking chains operated by ANZ Bank Samoa or Bank of Samoa, with the remittance purpose code referencing 'Capital Contribution and Share Subscription to Non-Resident Samoan International Company'. For offshore USD liquidity, the IC may maintain a Foreign Currency Deposit account, allowing wires to settle in USD without mandatory conversion. Verification protocol requires the depositing bank to hold the IC registration number, beneficial ownership declaration, and a board-minute authorization of the contributed capital. Capital inflows exceeding the total subscribed amount require a board resolution amending the issuance to permit a share capital increase; all injections must be cleared within the Samoan bank's statutory international transactions reporting window.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Service-based disbursements, including monthly retainer payments for media monitoring, PR counsel, and crisis communication retainers, are executed solely by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 COV credit transfers through the FCD or onshore WST account, with FX conversion executed at the spot interbank rate plus the bank's disclosed margin. Goods-embedded settlement or bundled production services involving physical print and broadcast materials route via commercial letter of credit using SWIFT MT700, with the LC governed by UCP600 and supported by transport documents, commercial invoices, and insurance certificates. Local currency disbursements above the WST 500,000 equivalent require prior Central Bank of Samoa balance-of-payments reporting and evidenced underlying trade or service contract; otherwise the outflow is blocked at the bank's system. The treasury holding structure should retain at least 120 days projected operating expenses in the settlement account to sustain clearing continuity.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST deliverable FX forwards, with one to six month tenors, offered by delegated licensed commercial banks for stabilization of recurring retainer outflows

Offshore USD/WST non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through approved international counterparty banks, explicitly outside onshore Central Bank of Samoa authorization but permissible under the non-resident status of the Samoan International Company

Cross-currency swap between USD and WST through a licensed Samoan commercial bank or a qualifying regional development partner, permitted only where the underlying contract is matched to a tangible operating liability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; Annual Return must be lodged within 1 calendar month of the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part of a month; if fees remain unpaid for 3 months, the Registrar may publish a strike-off notice and remove the company from the International Companies Register, causing dissolution and loss of limited liability. Reinstatement is discretionary and subject to payment of all arrears and penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for Samoa International Companies under the International Companies Act 2012. A certified independent audit becomes compulsory only where required by the company's By-Laws, a shareholder resolution, a financing or licensing agreement, or an Economic Substance filing obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily prescribed domestic accounting framework; International Companies commonly maintain accounts under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities (IFRS for SMEs).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Registered Agent must maintain and annually verify the Register of Members and Beneficial Ownership file. Each year, the International Company must deliver a signed annual confirmation of its current ultimate beneficial owners to the Registered Agent on or before the incorporation anniversary. Any share transfer must be lodged with the Registered Agent and recorded in the Register of Members within 21 days of transfer; issuance of bearer shares is restricted and requires prior Registrar approval.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,500 per annum (registered office and resident/registered agent fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 6,000 per engagement (voluntary audit only; no statutory audit mandate)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a compliant International Company under Section 199 of the International Companies Act 1987; Samoa's ordinary domestic corporate income tax rate is 25% under the Income Tax Act 2012, but this rate never applies to an exempt IC.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory zero-rate holiday: full exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, estate duty, gift duty and all Samoan withholding taxes; no CIT registration, no CIT return and no tax payment obligation for the IC while it remains non-resident in Samoa and conducts no domestic business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Samoan corporate income tax return is required for an International Company. The sole statutory compliance filing is the Annual Return of an International Company (prescribed form under the International Companies Regulations 1988, Schedule 1), filed by the licensed Resident Agent with the Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration (MCIL); paper filing through the agent; electronic lodgment available via the agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The first annual return is due within 12 months after the date of incorporation; subsequent returns are due within 12 months after the date of the most recent annual return, i.e., by each incorporation anniversary; a final return is required on deregistration or liquidation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation and the IC registration number issued by the Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the name matches all bank accounts, client retainer agreements and the resident agent's records; any change of name must be pre-approved by the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa maintained by the resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed resident agent's Samoa office address; a foreign operating address cannot be entered as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, license number and Samoa address of the licensed resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoa-licensed resident agent is mandatory for every IC; the agent holds custody of statutory records and the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, residential address, nationality and date of appointment of each director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are expressly permitted; no Samoan residency or nationality requirement applies to directors of an IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The secretary may be the resident agent, an individual, or a licensed corporate services provider; a non-resident secretary is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of shareholders, classes of shares, number of shares held and any nominee arrangement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited or immobilized; beneficial ownership details must be disclosed to the resident agent for AML/CFT purposes but are not part of the public Samoa register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital, issued capital and paid-up capital stated in the currency of denomination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; capital may be denominated in USD or any freely convertible currency; no paid-up capital is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Samoa, has not derived income from Samoan residents, and does not own Samoan land.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration is an offence and automatically forfeits the zero-tax exemption; the overseas PR firm must ensure no Samoan-source retainers, employees or premises are present.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a statutory late-payment surcharge of 10% on the outstanding annual government fee; two consecutive years of default allow the Registrar to strike the company off the register, causing loss of legal personality; restoration requires payment of all arrears, a restoration fee and Registrar consent. Knowingly false particulars constitute an offence punishable by a fine of up to WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 12 months, with liability extending to each director and the resident agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Certificate of Tax Exempt Status / Tax Residence Confirmation (not an annual filing): a letter issued on request by the Samoa Ministry of Revenue confirming the IC's zero-tax status under Section 199 of the International Companies Act 1987; used for bank onboarding, client due diligence and treaty relief requests.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory deadline; issued within 5-10 business days of a written application accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation and a copy of the latest annual return; valid for the calendar or fiscal year stated and reissued upon renewal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, IC registration number and date of incorporation of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the entity's details exactly as registered; foreign parent references are not entered on the certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Citation of Section 199, International Companies Act 1987 and confirmation that the IC is not subject to Samoa income tax, capital gains tax or withholding tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This field provides the legal basis for zero-rate treatment in foreign jurisdictions; no tax payment receipt can be provided because no tax is payable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year or calendar year for which the tax exempt status is confirmed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax authorities generally accept a current-dated certificate only; reapply annually.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the beneficial owner is not a Samoan resident and that no Samoan domestic business is conducted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership is permitted; a change of beneficial owner triggers reapplication.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Obtaining or presenting a false Certificate of Tax Exempt Status constitutes tax evasion and forgery, exposing the company, its directors and the resident agent to criminal fines up to WST 50,000, imprisonment, and mandatory information exchange with the requesting foreign tax authority.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - dividends, capital distributions and liquidation proceeds paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders are wholly exempt from Samoan withholding tax under Section 199 of the International Companies Act 1987; no dividend WHT is levied at source and no Samoan reporting or collection mechanism applies to outbound distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Source-country relief is normally unnecessary because Samoa imposes no withholding tax at source on IC distributions. Where a shareholder's residence jurisdiction requires treaty documentation, the protocol is: (1) confirm whether a relevant Samoa DTA exists - Samoa's treaty network is very limited and most agreements contain limitation-on-benefits clauses; (2) apply to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue for a Certificate of Tax Residence / Tax Exempt Status Certificate; (3) complete the payee's treaty relief form (e.g., IRS Form W-8BEN-E or the applicable foreign form); (4) submit the certificate and the relief form to the paying agent before the first payment; (5) revalidate annually or upon any material change. Fatal caution: because the IC pays zero Samoan tax, treaty benefits will generally be denied under limitation-on-benefits or anti-conduit rules; routing income through a Samoa IC for treaty shopping generates automatic exchange of information reporting and heightened audit risk.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% - interest and royalty payments made by a compliant Samoa International Company to any person, including non-residents, are exempt from Samoan withholding tax. Context: Samoa's Income Tax Act 2012 imposes a 15% final withholding tax on interest and royalties derived by non-residents from Samoan sources, but this applies only to domestic taxable companies and cannot apply to payments made by a zero-tax IC; treaty rates where applicable are generally 10-15% for interest and royalties, but remain irrelevant to exempt IC outbound flows.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies to Samoa International Companies because they sit outside the Samoan income tax net and are exempt from tax; no Local File or Master File is filed in Samoa. As an institutional best-practice and OECD-aligned risk benchmark, contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation (including an arm's length benchmarking study) should be prepared when annual gross cross-border related-party transactions - particularly intercompany recharges of media buying, global campaign production and management fees - reach WST 2,700,000 (approximately USD 1,000,000) per annum.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa, as an OECD 'no or only nominal tax' jurisdiction, has committed to economic substance requirements for International Companies carrying on relevant activities, which include service centers, headquarters, distribution, financing, banking, insurance, shipping and IP holding. A global PR and communications firm is a 'service center' type business: the core income-generating activities - client contracting, campaign strategy, media negotiation, contract risk management, and invoice approval - must be genuinely conducted in Samoa through a physical office with full-time employees, local board meetings and contemporaneous decision-making records. Alternatively, the IC may rely on the foreign-resident-parent substance exemption by demonstrating that the relevant income is subject to a substantial foreign tax regime. Failure to meet these requirements triggers a civil penalty of up to WST 50,000 per infraction, rectification orders, strike-off for persistent non-compliance, spontaneous exchange of information with the shareholders' tax authorities, and classification of the IC as a shell entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Misuse of the Section 199 IC Tax Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on actual business with Samoan residents or deriving Samoan-source income under the cover of the IC exemption - e.g., accepting retainers from Samoan government ministries or local corporates, hiring Samoan employees, leasing Samoan premises, or owning Samoan land while filing the Section 199 no-domestic-business declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic forfeiture of the zero-tax exemption; compulsory conversion to or re-registration as a domestic company; back-assessment of corporate income tax at 25% for all open years (up to 6 prior fiscal years); late payment interest at approximately 12% per annum; penalty of up to 150% of the tax shortfall; deregistration and prohibition from the IC register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent are jointly and severally liable for all unpaid tax and penalties; civil restitution orders for concealed profits; travel bans and asset freezing; criminal prosecution for tax evasion carrying a fine of up to USD 100,000 and/or imprisonment up to 14 years; permanent disqualification from acting as a director of a Samoa company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Failure (OECD ESR)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Zero physical presence in Samoa; no full-time employees; all strategic and operational decisions taken offshore by a foreign parent; the registered agent's address used merely as a mail-drop; PR retainer contracts negotiated, executed and managed entirely outside Samoa while the IC claims Samoa substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic substance penalty of up to WST 50,000 per company per infraction; mandatory rectification notice; Registry strike-off for persistent default; referral to the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices; automatic exchange of information with the beneficial owner's home tax authority; termination of correspondent banking relations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally fined, disqualified from holding office and named in integrated information-exchange disclosures; travel bans pending rectification; in aggravated cases, civil liability to creditors and the estate for operating a sham offshore structure.
